english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
target: 您的文件只保留在您的裝置上
backtrans: Your documents stay only on your device

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: 您的整個文件辦公室 — 掃描、編輯、簽名、匯出 — 盡在一個私密的應用程式。
backtrans: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, export — all in one private app.

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: 標註、簽名、浮水印、填寫表單、蓋章等 — 全部免費無限制。
backtrans: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, stamp and more — all free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: KatharScan 支援 {count} 種語言。OCR 在您的手機上執行——任何內容都不會離開您的裝置。
backtrans: KatharScan supports {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing leaves your device.

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: 電子簽署合約、點選填寫表單、幾秒內加蓋企業印章。
backtrans: Electronically sign contracts, tap to fill in forms, add a corporate seal in seconds.

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: 每次編輯都可逆 — 隨時復原、重做、恢復原始。
backtrans: Every edit is reversible — undo, redo, restore the original at any time.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: 無帳號、無雲端、無浮水印。您的文件永不離開裝置。
backtrans: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave the device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: 透過一次性購買支援 KatharScan。所有功能保持免費。
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features stay free.

english: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it anytime on any device with the same store account.
target: 這是一次性購買。使用同一商店帳號即可隨時在任何裝置上還原。
backtrans: This is a one-time purchase. You can restore it at any time on any device using the same store account.

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: KatharScan 在顯示此畫面時遇到問題。您的掃描是安全的——它們儲存在此裝置上，這不會影響它們。
backtrans: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they are stored on this device, and this does not affect them.
